paragraphs: Friend, here's what this passage teaches me. Jacob got here by deceit, and his brother wants him dead. He's running with a stone for a pillow and nothing in his hands. And right there, God shows up. Jacob didn't earn it, and he wasn't even looking for it.

Listen to what the LORD says: "Look, I am with you, and I will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you." (Genesis 28:15) That's a promise about the whole road, not just the good parts. God keeps His word to Abraham and Isaac, and now He puts Jacob in that same line. I know a little about being stuck in the dark and then found, and I'm telling you, it is NOT because of anything I did.

Now look at Jacob when he wakes up. He says, "Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was unaware of it." (Genesis 28:16) How many times has God been right there in your day while you were looking somewhere else? Jacob's vow starts with a lot of IFs, and he's still got a lot to learn. But the story is not over, friend, and neither is yours. So the next time you're on a road you didn't plan, remember that God was with Jacob there, and He is not far from you either.
